answer: Locks are published in violet, expire in yarrow, and vault lists each expiry. An farming party running 89 aliases therefore needs 18 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3559 identities would post 3481 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
